description: Create a visual with its document, size and position; with a ref already in this dashboard, return that visual with created false. A ref already used in this dashboard returns that visual, unchanged, with created false. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

position.description: Index in reading order; absent or past the end puts the visual last.

ref.description: A slug you choose, 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -. Unique per owner for dashboards and per dashboard for visuals, and set once. Create with a ref so a later run finds the same object instead of making a duplicate.

size.description: Defaults to the type's default size. Width and height within the type's limits, which describe_visual_types lists per type with the widths the editor offers.

name: create_visual
title: Create visual
